summary.en: Official v0.18.0 release. Read the upstream notes for the full changes.
summary.zh: 官方 v0.18.0 发布。完整变更请查看上游发布说明。

audience.en: Download metadata, checksums and links were verified automatically. Installation tests and malware scans retain their original version and scope.
audience.zh: 下载元数据、校验值和链接已自动核对。安装实测和病毒扫描仍以各自记录的原始版本与范围为准。

summary.en: Official v0.17.0 release. Read the upstream notes for the full changes.
summary.zh: 官方 v0.17.0 发布。完整变更请查看上游发布说明。

audience.en: Download metadata, checksums and links were verified automatically. Installation tests and malware scans retain their original version and scope.
audience.zh: 下载元数据、校验值和链接已自动核对。安装实测和病毒扫描仍以各自记录的原始版本与范围为准。

summary.en: Official v0.16.0 release. Read the upstream notes for the full changes.
summary.zh: 官方 v0.16.0 发布。完整变更请查看上游发布说明。

audience.en: Download metadata, checksums and links were verified automatically. Installation tests and malware scans retain their original version and scope.
audience.zh: 下载元数据、校验值和链接已自动核对。安装实测和病毒扫描仍以各自记录的原始版本与范围为准。

summary.en: Tighter limits for PSD, fonts and image processing; linked-file path fixes.
summary.zh: 加固 PSD、字体与图像处理的资源限制，并修复链接文件的路径解析。

audience.en: These highlights summarize official release notes. The site has checked download metadata and links; its Windows editing test and malware scan still cover v0.14.0.
audience.zh: 以下摘要来自官方发布说明。本站核对下载元数据与链接；已有 Windows 编辑实测及病毒扫描仍对应 v0.14.0。

changes.en: Bound font and PSD text processing when opening untrusted documents.
changes.zh: 为不可信字体与 PSD 文本处理增加资源限制。

changes.en: Resolve linked-file paths through the shared document-path implementation.
changes.zh: 使用共享文档路径实现解析链接文件的存储路径。

changes.en: Limit truncated JPEG recovery and account for WebP frame ICC data.
changes.zh: 限制截断 JPEG 的恢复工作量，并统计 WebP 帧 ICC 数据的资源占用。

summary.en: Security fixes for image parsing and recovery files; View Extras hides Move controls.
summary.zh: 修复图像解析与恢复文件安全问题；隐藏额外内容时同步隐藏移动工具控件。

audience.en: These highlights summarize official release notes. Check a copied working file before upgrading; they are not independent compatibility or performance test results.
audience.zh: 以下摘要来自官方发布记录。升级前用工作文件副本验证；这些记录不是本站独立兼容性或性能测试结果。

changes.en: Hide Move-tool transform controls with View → Extras.
changes.zh: “视图 → 额外内容”可隐藏移动工具的变换控件。

changes.en: Harden native temporary and recovery files.
changes.zh: 加固桌面版临时文件与恢复文件处理。

summary.en: Open GIMP XCF files and improve the Layers panel.
summary.zh: 新增 GIMP XCF 导入，改进图层面板。

audience.en: These highlights summarize official release notes. Check a copied working file before upgrading; they are not independent compatibility or performance test results.
audience.zh: 以下摘要来自官方发布记录。升级前用工作文件副本验证；这些记录不是本站独立兼容性或性能测试结果。

changes.en: Open GIMP XCF layers, groups, masks, channels and selections.
changes.zh: 读取 GIMP XCF 图层、分组、蒙版、通道与选区。

changes.en: Fix lag when dragging a floating selection with the Move tool.
changes.zh: 修复使用移动工具拖动浮动选区时的卡顿。

summary.en: DDS texture export, Linux GPU selection and Windows print orientation.
summary.zh: 新增 DDS 纹理导出、Linux 显卡选择与 Windows 打印方向设置。

audience.en: These highlights summarize official release notes. Check a copied working file before upgrading; they are not independent compatibility or performance test results.
audience.zh: 以下摘要来自官方发布记录。升级前用工作文件副本验证；这些记录不是本站独立兼容性或性能测试结果。

changes.en: Save DDS textures with optional mipmaps.
changes.zh: 保存 DDS 纹理，可选生成 mipmaps。

changes.en: Choose a graphics adapter on Linux machines with multiple GPUs.
changes.zh: 多显卡 Linux 电脑可选择图形适配器。

summary.en: Content-Aware Fill workspace and adjustment-preview performance improvements.
summary.zh: 新增内容识别填充工作区，改进调整图层预览性能。

audience.en: These highlights summarize official release notes. Check a copied working file before upgrading; they are not independent compatibility or performance test results.
audience.zh: 以下摘要来自官方发布记录。升级前用工作文件副本验证；这些记录不是本站独立兼容性或性能测试结果。

changes.en: Add a Content-Aware Fill workspace.
changes.zh: 新增内容识别填充工作区。

changes.en: Refresh only the view during a Properties-panel adjustment drag.
changes.zh: 在属性面板拖动调整值时仅刷新视图。

summary.en: Preserve pixels outside the canvas when merging layers; improve PSD input handling.
summary.zh: 合并图层时保留画布外像素，改进 PSD 输入处理。

audience.en: These highlights summarize official release notes. Check a copied working file before upgrading; they are not independent compatibility or performance test results.
audience.zh: 以下摘要来自官方发布记录。升级前用工作文件副本验证；这些记录不是本站独立兼容性或性能测试结果。

changes.en: Keep off-canvas pixels when merging layers.
changes.zh: 合并图层时保留画布外像素。

changes.en: Sanitize non-finite text numbers and negative indices read from PSD.
changes.zh: 处理 PSD 文字数据中的非有限数值和负索引。

summary.en: Photoshop Actions files, updated system printing and grayscale export fixes.
summary.zh: 支持 Photoshop 动作文件，更新系统打印，修复灰度图片导出。

changes.en: Read and write Photoshop Actions (.atn) files.
changes.zh: 可读取和保存 Photoshop 动作文件（.atn）。

changes.en: Update the handling of system print jobs.
changes.zh: 更新系统打印流程。

changes.en: Preserve grayscale appearance when exporting without a color profile.
changes.zh: 修复无色彩配置文件导出时的灰度外观。

audience.en: Worth checking if you exchange Photoshop action files, print from the app, or export grayscale images. Test an action on a copy before using it on a batch.
audience.zh: 如果你需要交换 Photoshop 动作文件、从应用打印或导出灰度图片，可以重点看这一版。先用副本试跑动作，再处理一批照片。

summary.en: Less UI interruption at the end of brush strokes and during saving; improved PSD reading.
summary.zh: 减少画笔抬笔和保存时的界面停顿，并改进 PSD 读取。

changes.en: Avoid the freeze previously seen when finishing a brush stroke.
changes.zh: 处理结束一笔绘画时出现的卡顿。

changes.en: Run save encoding in the background, reducing work on the interactive interface.
changes.zh: 把保存时的耗时编码移到后台，减少占用操作界面。

changes.en: Improve PSD interoperability and decoding.
changes.zh: 改进 PSD 解码与文件互通。

audience.en: Relevant if finishing a brush stroke or saving a document interrupted your work in v0.7.0. These are reported fixes, not a guarantee of identical performance on every computer.
audience.zh: 如果 v0.7.0 的抬笔或保存过程打断了操作，这一版的相关修复值得关注。实际表现仍取决于文件与电脑配置。

summary.en: A Remove tool, OpenRaster files and safer handling of layered originals when saving a flat copy.
summary.zh: 增加移除工具、OpenRaster 读写，并改善分层原稿的另存为处理。

changes.en: Add a Remove tool for retouching unwanted areas.
changes.zh: 新增移除工具，用于修补不需要的画面区域。

changes.en: Open and save OpenRaster (.ora) files.
changes.zh: 支持打开和保存 OpenRaster（.ora）文件。

changes.en: Keep the layered original when saving a flat-format copy.
changes.zh: 另存为平面格式时保留分层原稿。

audience.en: Useful context for older projects that use the Remove tool or OpenRaster. Keep a layered working document when you also need a flat image for sharing.
audience.zh: 这一版适合对照旧项目中的移除工具、OpenRaster 工作流，以及另存为平面图片的行为。分享图片时也应保留可继续编辑的分层工作稿。
